text: Keep the hook-off flag in .git or move it to .bowman/runtime?

status.comment: Felix 2026-10-16: move it. The flag is now .bowman/runtime/continue-hook-disabled (gitignored with the rest of runtime/). The hook script, continueHookStatus, enable and disable still honor the old .git flag and clear it on the next toggle; disable also upgrades recognized older hook copies. This clone's flag was moved (hook still off). Tests: continue-hook 4/4 incl. a legacy-flag test, hook contract PASS.
